source_note: 函数与序列的上下极限
english_source_note: Limsup and Liminf of Functions and Sequences
callout_id: 函数与序列的上下极限#8
statement_en:
Suppose $x_n>0$. In the extended real sense (with the conventions $1/0=+\infty$ and $1/\infty=0$):
1. $$\limsup_{ n\to +\infty}\frac{1}{x_n} =\frac{1}{\liminf_{ n\to +\infty}x_n}$$
2. $$\liminf_{ n\to +\infty}\frac{1}{x_n} =\frac{1}{\limsup_{ n\to +\infty}x_n}$$
key_techniques: monotonicity of the reciprocal map on positive numbers
callout_body:
设$x_n>0$。在拓展实数意义下（约定$1/0=+\infty,1/\infty=0$）那么
1. $$\limsup_{ n\to +\infty}\frac{1}{x_n} =\frac{1}{\liminf_{ n\to +\infty}x_n}$$
2. $$\liminf_{ n\to +\infty}\frac{1}{x_n} =\frac{1}{\limsup_{ n\to +\infty}x_n}$$
